test_helpers.why: the fp32 oracle (gated_attention_block_reference), build_rope_tables, make_inputs, RefGeometry: what a FlashInfer correctness test compares against (the quantized / backward refs inside import test-tree siblings lazily and are not used)

extra_files.why: the retired Python frame implementation of the SDPA launch binder (bind_dense / bind_dense_split / bind_thd, the paged pools and tables, the split combine): the frame logic the FlashInfer-side Python binder delegates to, vendored as sdpa/fwd/_binding_reference.py

excluded.cudnn: the package root: loads the nanobind extension; the vendored root is written fresh (shim)
excluded.cudnn._compiled_module: the nanobind extension (.so): NOT vendored; its Python-visible surface is shimmed
excluded.cudnn.graph: the classic graph API facade (graph / jit / graph_cache): the block never uses it
excluded.cudnn.gated_attention_block.api_bwd: the training half (backward); dropped from the vendored package __init__ (patch P0)
